# Tunnel Pilot

> Tunnel Pilot is a free, open-source SSH local port forwarding manager. It ships as two products built from one codebase with identical features: Tunnel Pilot (desktop), a tray app with a window for macOS, Windows and Linux, and Tunnel Pilot CLI (server), a daemon with no window, managed from the terminal and from a web UI.

Tunnel Pilot replaces repeated `ssh -L` commands with saved forwards that can be toggled, grouped and kept connected.

## Shared Features (both products)

- Save SSH local port forwards (local port, remote host, remote port) with password or identity-file authentication
- Groups/folders and tags
- Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff and SSH keep-alive liveness
- Live per-tunnel stats and an activity log
- Backup export and import (backups never contain passwords)
- Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette
- Passwords stored in the OS keychain, or a separate 0600 file when no keychain is available
- License: MIT; source: https://github.com/kalfian/tunnel-pilot

## Tunnel Pilot (desktop)

- Page: https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/
- Command: `tunnel-pilot`
- What: a tray / menu-bar app with a window; idles in roughly 15–30 MB of RAM (Rust + Tauri)
- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux
- Install (macOS / Linux / WSL): `curl -fsSL https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/install.sh | bash`
- Install (Windows): `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/install.ps1 | iex"`
- Uninstall (macOS / Linux): `curl -fsSL https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/uninstall.sh | bash` (keeps forwards and settings; add `-s -- --purge` to delete them and the stored passwords)
- Updates: automatic, cryptographically signed and verified with minisign
- Launch at login; the window can stay closed while tunnels run from the tray
- Terminal CLI (macOS / Linux): the `tunnel-pilot` binary talks to the running app: `list`, `status`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `add`, `edit`, `remove`, `set-password`, all with `--json`
- Downloads: https://github.com/kalfian/tunnel-pilot/releases/latest

## Tunnel Pilot CLI (server)

- Page: https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/cli/
- Command: `tunnel-pilot-cli`
- What: the same features with no window; a daemon managed from the terminal and from a web UI in the browser (the same interface as the desktop app). For servers, homelabs, a Raspberry Pi and CI boxes
- Platforms: Linux x86_64 and aarch64 (static binary, any distro; links only libc) and macOS; not Windows
- Size: a single binary of about 10 MB
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/cli/install.sh | bash` (installs to ~/.local/bin, or /usr/local/bin with `-s -- --system` or as root; SHA-256 verified, refused if the checksum is missing or wrong)
- Uninstall: `curl -fsSL https://kalfian.github.io/tunnel-pilot/cli/uninstall.sh | bash` (stops and removes the service and binary; `-s -- --purge` also deletes config, the web admin password and stored passwords)
- Quick start: `tunnel-pilot-cli web set-password`, then `tunnel-pilot-cli service install --web` (web UI on http://127.0.0.1:1855) or `tunnel-pilot-cli service install --web --bind 0.0.0.0` (reachable at http://<server-ip>:1855)
- Terminal: `tunnel-pilot-cli add prod-db --ssh deploy@bastion.example.com --forward 5432:db.internal:5432 --identity ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`; also `list`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `status`, all with `--json`
- Runs as: a systemd service (user unit, or system unit as root) or a launchd agent; tunnels auto-reconnect
- Web UI security: login always required (admin password hashed with argon2id), HttpOnly SameSite=Strict session cookie, CSRF protection, per-IP login rate limiting, strict Content-Security-Policy; binds 127.0.0.1 by default and 0.0.0.0 only when chosen with `--bind`
- No built-in TLS: when exposing beyond localhost, put an HTTPS reverse proxy in front (Caddy: `reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:1855`; nginx: also `proxy_set_header Host $host;` plus WebSocket `Upgrade`/`Connection` headers) or reach it through an SSH tunnel. The UI warns when it is reached over plain HTTP from a non-loopback host

## Choosing Between Them

- Laptop or workstation, any OS, want a tray icon: Tunnel Pilot (desktop)
- Server, homelab, Raspberry Pi, CI box, or no desktop session: Tunnel Pilot CLI
- Windows: desktop only
- Both can be installed on one machine; they keep separate config. Move forwards between them with backup export/import

## Important URLs
